key.name: credentials-path
key.description: Local Codex credentials file. A leading ~/ is resolved to the user's home directory.

key.name: auto-apply-banked-reset
key.description: Redeem a banked reset automatically within 1 hour of expiry.

key.name: auto-apply-banked-reset-on-usage
key.summary: Auto-redeem when remaining usage is low
key.description: Redeem the banked reset nearest to expiry when an eligible window has less than 2% quota remaining. Skip windows that reset soon. Check only after a successful usage refresh.

key.name: banked-reset-usage-policy-migrated
key.description: Records the one-time reset of the low-quota redemption opt-in when its threshold and window rules changed.

key.name: banked-reset-skip-minutes
key.description: Minutes before a scheduled reset to skip low-quota auto-redemption, by usage window ID. Set a window to 0 to turn off its skip period. Set the full window length to disable low-quota auto-redemption for that window.

key.name: usage-notifications
key.description: Notify after successful usage refreshes when a window runs low, is exhausted, or resets after exhaustion. Send each alert once per window per quota cycle. Exclude banked resets. Clear notification state when notifications or the extension are disabled.

key.name: usage-notification-threshold
key.description: Percentage remaining at or below which to warn when usage notifications are enabled.
